question: Single-photon 297 nm transition strength (dipole matrix element) of Rb 5S1/2 -> nP1/2,3/2 and the laser power required to drive it at MHz Rabi frequencies.

ionization_energy_Rb87.source: ARC alkali_atom_data (Rb-87), ref Sanguinetti2009; NIST ASD
ionization_energy_Rb87.quote: we obtain an improved ionisation energy of E_i = 1 010 024 700(7) MHz  (Sanguinetti2009, data/papers/0905.0571/paper.tex, for 85Rb; Rb-87 differs only by the isotope shift <0.01 cm-1, negligible here)
ionization_energy_Rb87.anchored_to: reproduces 85Rb n=36..63 P3/2 Rydberg level energies (Sanguinetti2009)

rydberg_cm1.source: reduced-mass Rydberg constant Ry = m_e/(m+m_e) Ry_infinity (ARC scaledRydbergConstant)

qdefect_P12.anchored_to: reproduces Rb nP1/2 Rydberg level energies (Li2003)

qdefect_P32.anchored_to: reproduces Rb nP3/2 Rydberg level energies (Li2003, Sanguinetti2009)

d2_reduced_reference_a0.source: Safronova et al., Phys. Rev. A 60, 4476 (1999), table V (coupled-cluster)
d2_reduced_reference_a0.anchored_to: reproduces Rb D2 5S1/2->5P3/2 reduced matrix element (and D2 linewidth 2pi*6.065 MHz)

manthey_anchor.quote: with a Rabi frequency of Omega=2pi x 90 kHz (SEM_UV.tex Eq.4); UV laser (I=7 mW, w=700 um, Delta=2pi x 10 MHz) (SEM_UV.tex Fig caption)
manthey_anchor.anchored_to: measured on-resonance Rabi frequency of 5S1/2->38P3/2 excitation in a Rb BEC

invariants.qdefect_reconciliation_note: E2 uses the pairinteraction QDT database (Li2003/Sansonetti2006) with δ(P₁/₂)=2.65486, δ(P₃/₂)=2.64150; the ARC set used here (2.6548849 / 2.6416737) differs by ≤1.7×10⁻⁴, a benign ≈2.6 MHz level shift at n=75 that does not affect the n≈75.3 mapping.

computed.acceptance_criterion: CONFIRMED iff (a) computed.d2_reduced_a0 reproduces the published D2 reduced matrix element (Safronova 5.956 a0) within 1% (0.99 <= d2_ratio_vs_safronova <= 1.01) AND (b) computed.rabi_38P_khz reproduces Manthey2014's measured 2pi x 90 kHz within a factor 1.5 (0.5 <= rabi_38P_ratio_vs_90khz <= 1.5); REFUTED otherwise. Verdict reads computed.acceptance_passed.

method_ladder.field_standard_method: dipole x Gaussian peak field / hbar (Piotrowicz2011 Eq.2)

cross_validation_plan.control_method: Manthey2014 measured Rabi 90 kHz at n=38, 7 mW, 700 um
Safronova1999 coupled-cluster D2 reduced matrix element 5.956 a0

cross_validation.method_a: ARC Numerov dipole + Gaussian-beam Rabi formula

single-photon Rabi frequency 5S1/2 -> 38P3/2 at 7 mW, 700 um waist (kHz, peak field)
